contract: Riven-owned block variety, shared by native cubes and the DH preview; no block changes the land's shape.
Named palettes are for wonders, which bring their own rock (riven-wonders.json): their strata band from the wonder's floor upward, under soil too.

Exposed rock and all rock below the soil come from the geology (riven-geology.json); these palettes serve only wonders, banded in their top depthBlocks: strata thicknessBlocks thick, tilted by up to tiltBlocks over tiltWavelengthBlocks, each band picked by a hash of the band index.
Soil Riven places as sand rests on sandstoneDepthBlocks of sandstone. A sandy shore whose coast shoals less than gravelBeachBelowShoaling (a steep, reflective coast) is gravel instead.

Grass on soil steeper than coarseDirtAboveSlope (the smoothed broad slope, which stays under about 0.2 on soil) is coarse dirt, and gravel above gravelAboveSlope: about 7% and 2% of soil on the main seed.
River and lake beds of dirt are clay in patches where a value noise of wavelengthBlocks exceeds threshold.
